title: Pet Of The Year Play-Off
overview: Nikie St. Gilles, Jessica James, Heather St. James, Samantha Michaels, Tania Russof: five beautiful women whose names you might not be familiar with but whose looks will leave you breathless. These are the Penthouse Pets who are vying for the coveted title of Penthouse Pet of the Year. In this one-of-a-kind play-off directed by Nicholas Guccione, these fabulous women of Penthouse share their erotic pleasures with you, the voters, who will decide their fate. Tantalizing scenarios with a sci-fi twist, Far East fantasies, enticing fetishes and alluring bedroom seductions ... it's the sexiest Penthouse video yet. Pet of the Year Play-Off 1998 the one election you'll want to win.
